verticalDatum: Decoded public Terrarium meters. Numeric anchor height is a working datum only; exact regional vertical reference is unverified. No ellipsoidal conversion asserted.

limits: Terrarium tile pixel spacing and 4 m review grid do not establish native DEM resolution or vertical accuracy. The source smooths this small rocky knoll.
Public Romanian terrain service was unreachable on retrieval day; no local LiDAR or surveyed architectural elevation is asserted.
Courtyard floor is reconstructed from highest mapped outer-boundary sample plus 0.25 m. Global floor translation preserves photo-guided relative facade heights; no per-window terrain warping.
Occupied perimeter feet follow the retained terrain with a buried allowance; court paving is architectural, not a duplicate geological hill.
Exact vertical reference, terrain vintage, cliff/rock edge, vegetation contamination and compatibility with other host terrain products remain unverified.
